method: Viewed both exact exported USDZ Apple SceneKit snapshots with functions.view_image; inspected original model JSON and canonical native SceneSpec. No output edits or retries.

improvementObserved.interpretation: Separating assembly structure bounded the runaway part graph in this one attempt and produced a more chair-like silhouette. This does not establish visual correctness or generalization.

failures.finding: Four named legs occupy only two distinct physical centers.
failures.causeBoundary: The stage-two model supplied yOffset +/-0.02 for front/back legs and omitted zOffset. Under the unchanged, explicitly documented bottom-face solver, normal Y offset is ignored; front/back centers collapse. No solver or output repair was applied.

failures.finding: Backrest is centered through the seating depth instead of placed at the rear.
failures.causeBoundary: Actual stage-one purpose says behind the seat, but stage two omitted a Z displacement. The fixed graph alone did not preserve that spatial meaning.

failures.finding: Seating surface is higher than the approximately 0.45m request.
The outline adds a separate full box base_frame under the seat.
failures.interpretation: The model chose a broad solid support plate rather than a sparse frame. It is an additional visible horizontal slab; it is not a human-authored fallback. Do not infer a ground platform violation solely from its name because the resolved plate is elevated.

appearanceNote: Both fixed-lighting previews show pale surfaces although the model specified dark brown #5D4037. This is recorded as preview appearance, not an established iPhone color-rendering defect.
outlineScopeDeviation: The outline had no typed dimensions/coordinates, but its free purpose strings echoed Y=0 and Y=0.45m despite the instruction to omit coordinates. Those actual strings were retained verbatim in stage two; no semantic text filter or repair was applied.
formatEvidence: format-validation.json: GLB validator zero errors/warnings; USDZ CRC/stored/alignment and exact Apple import/two renders passed. Format success is separate from this visual failure.
limits: Single-root connected structure is a prototype restriction, not an adopted multi-object product contract
No claim that a different object or repeated request will show the same improvement
No accepted retry or result repair
